patthana15.63:1.1: kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nakāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nakāmāvacaro na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana15.63:2.1: kāmāvacaraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nakāmāvacaro na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. abyākatamūlaṃ dve. rūpāvacaraduka kusalattike narūpāvacaraduka nakusalattikaṃ
